benchmark: Domain setup end-to-end (Phase 1, full thesis boundary)

includes: FROST distributed key generation and self-test
PVSS administrator encryption-key setup and ECDH self-tests
Groth16 trusted setup for auth, link, and PVSS circuits
initial SignedRoot version 0 creation and threshold-signature verification
metadata.groth16_note: The current src/setup.js records ZK artifacts as pending. This benchmark explicitly performs the Groth16 per-circuit key-generation step because the thesis defines that step as part of Phase 1. Existing project build ZKeys are never overwritten.
metadata.state_isolation: private/frost, private/pvss, state/frost, state/pvss, state/roots and setup result files are snapshotted and restored byte-for-byte after every sample.
metadata.worker_isolation: Each sample executes in a fresh Node worker process to avoid cross-sample crypto backend/GC contamination.
